title: AquaFeed Pro wire contract 2.7.0
description: Breaking major 2 contract. Major 1 has no nozzle targeting and is rejected with PROTOCOL_UNSUPPORTED; no fallback or silent default nozzle.

UtcDateTime.description: Valid calendar timestamp in UTC, with the required Z suffix.

IanaTimeZone.description: Resolve names case-insensitively against the IANA database for runtime use; reject plain numeric UTC offsets. Preserve the submitted identifier for configuration equality.

amount_g.description: Requested feed weight in grams; bounds and increment come from the approved per-device profile.

fixed_portion_id.description: Opaque ID selected from this device's advertised fixed_portion_ids; no gram amount is implied.

Dose.description: Discriminated dose. Unknown mode values fail validation.

RunEventOutcome.description: skipped is a scheduled occurrence outcome, not a command state.

feed_remaining_monitoring.description: One shared container/load-cell inventory, never per-nozzle stock.

feed_capacity_g.description: Capacity of the shared container. Null means unknown; it does not set any nozzle dose limit.

scheduled_both.description: True only when the device executes a two-target schedule as one ordered Both sequence. False rejects Both schedules.

maximum_settling_ms.description: Device-wide maximum settling interval; null means no verified bound.

CapabilityProfile.description: Shared device monitoring, hopper capacity and schedule limits plus exactly two independent nozzle dose capabilities.

metadata_conflict.description: True while legacy per-phone labels disagreed and no phone has chosen the shared value yet.

DeviceMetadata.description: Shared feeder name and location, identical for every authorized installation.

PairingWindowResponse.description: Device-only secret response; never log or send the machine credential to the phone. Physical presentation is hardware-owned.

seen_work_token.description: Opaque work watermark from the previous wait response; null requests an immediate current value.

work_token.description: Opaque wake-up watermark only; it contains no work details and is not a clock sample.

changed.description: False only when the wait reached its 20 second timeout without a change.

AliasUpdateRequest.description: Replaces the shared feeder name and location if expected_revision is still current; null clears. A stale revision is rejected with METADATA_CONFLICT.

ManualFeedRequest.description: Confirmation binds the route device and ordered nozzle+dose targets. Idempotency includes target order, each dose and capabilities_revision; request_id is correlation only.

CommandAcceptedResponse.description: start_before gates only the first nozzle; the device-wide reservation remains through later stops and settling.

LockoutResolution.description: Device-authenticated physical maintenance can clear safety lockout without fabricating a physical outcome.

CommandStatusDTO.description: Sequence status aggregates ordered nozzle results. partial has exactly one completed nozzle: nozzle 1 completed with nozzle 2 failed, unknown or not_started, or nozzle 1 failed with a proven continuation and nozzle 2 completed.

HistoryTotals.description: Exact counts across all matching records, using the page's device, date, source, and status filters.

HistoryRecord.description: A durable sequence with requested doses and separate measured results per nozzle. Null measurements remain unavailable.

HistoryPageResponse.description: One 50-row maximum keyset page; totals use the identical filters over every matching record.

HistoryDetailResponse.description: Read-only selected-device sequence detail; it never causes device actuation.

CommandByKeyResponse.description: Looks up the original command using the same device, installation, and idempotency key.

ManualFeedRecoveryResponse.description: created: a terminal rejected no-feed receipt now fences the saved key. existing: the key already had a command, returned unchanged. Never starts a feed.

MonitoringLimits.description: Dissolved oxygen is mg/L; thresholds are configuration only, not biological advice.

weekdays.description: ISO weekday numbers Monday=1 through Sunday=7.

targets.description: One nozzle, or Both as nozzle 1 then nozzle 2 with a separate dose each. Legacy scalar nozzle_number/dose schedules are no longer accepted.

Schedule.description: One logical schedule. Both shares one schedule_id and one occurrence per local date; it runs as one ordered sequence.

ConfigurationWriteRequest.description: Submit a complete snapshot with compare-and-swap base revision; no partial schedule patch exists.

ConfigurationWriteResponse.description: receipt is immutable for the original request; current_state is a fresh view and may report applied, rejected, or a later desired revision on replay. API acceptance is not device application.

ConfigurationWriteReceipt.description: The immutable accepted full snapshot created by this request.

ConfigurationCurrentState.description: Current aggregate state, independent of the immutable receipt returned for an earlier request replay.

TelemetryValues.description: A measurement value is present only with quality valid. Invalid device time has measured_at null; uncertain device time is retained but cannot be promoted to a trusted current reading.

LiveTelemetrySample.description: The current-boot sample whose sequence equals the enclosing per-device live_sequence.

HistoricalTelemetrySample.description: An immutable backlog record keyed by boot_id and sequence. Backlog replay never replaces or refreshes the current live sample.

RunEvent.description: Each event is one nozzle step in a stable sequence_id/event_sequence stream; device reservation spans actuation and settling. Absent or null continuation_evidence never continues to nozzle 2 after a nozzle 1 failure.

device_fault.description: No device-wide fault or lockout exists.

baseline_ready_at.description: Device time of the fresh valid settled shared-scale baseline. Nozzle 2 must start by this time plus scheduler_wake_grace_ms.

ContinuationEvidence.description: Device-authored proof, bound to its sequence and step 1, that a failed nozzle 1 may continue to the already-authorized nozzle 2 once. Nozzle 1 is never retried.

live_sequence.description: Per-device monotonic live counter that survives reboots; when latest_sample is present, its sequence must equal this value.

latest_sample.description: Current live sample for the enclosing boot_id; historical backlog is separate and cannot update the current sample pointer.

backlog_samples.description: Bounded immutable history. At most 100 samples total are accepted; the live sample counts toward that limit.

DeviceSyncRequest.description: Authenticated device sync. Runtime validation also requires latest_sample.sequence to equal live_sequence and rejects duplicate identities within one body. Persist samples and contact atomically, and ACK only identities durably stored. Old, future, uncertain, or invalid device time cannot create a fresh trusted metric.

scheduler_wake_grace_ms.description: For Both, nozzle 2 must start by the first valid settled completion time plus this device bound.

CommandDelivery.description: One durable ordered sequence; later nozzles require prior stop and a valid settled shared-weight baseline.

acknowledged_samples.description: Only exact sample identities durably inserted or confirmed as immutable duplicates are acknowledged.

DeviceSyncResponse.description: Sample ACKs mean those immutable identities are durably stored; they do not imply that historical replay replaced current state.

NozzleCapability.description: Approved capability for one nozzle. Null limits are unknown, not zero.

ManualFeedTargets.description: One selected nozzle, or exactly nozzle 1 followed by nozzle 2.

NozzleResult.description: Requested, estimated and measured amounts stay separate. Unknown and not_started results never invent measurements.

NozzleResults.description: Results retain target order and include not_started steps.

ScheduledOccurrenceTarget.description: Occurrence identity is device_id + schedule_id + local date; nozzle, dose and revision are not identity.

ScheduledSequenceAdmission.description: Admit same-time due occurrences atomically under one device reservation. first_start_before gates target 1 only; target 2 starts only after nozzle 1 stops and a valid settled shared-weight baseline. Its deadline is baseline_ready_at + scheduler_wake_grace_ms. A null settling limit is unknown, never zero.

ConfigurationReadResponse.description: Authorized desired/applied snapshot read; a missing request receipt remains unresolved and does not authorize a replacement request key.

targets.description: Same-time cross-nozzle occurrences are returned together in nozzle 1 then nozzle 2 order.

NextAppliedOccurrenceResponse.description: Calculated from the device-applied revision only; pending and rejected desired edits never appear as next feeding.

MonitoringDisplayPolicy.description: Display defaults only; they are not firmware cadence, detection, or hardware guarantees.

MonitoringCurrentSample.description: Current pointer only. Untrusted or unsupported values are returned unavailable; stale trusted values retain their timestamp.

MonitoringSnapshotResponse.description: Protected selected-device monitoring state. Contact age is server-authenticated; it remains distinct from sensor availability and sample freshness.

DoGraphBucket.description: One equal-width graph bin. The newest sample in a bin determines its value or gap, so a later invalid reading cannot be hidden by an earlier valid one.

DoGraphResponse.description: Protected equal-width aggregation. Time bounds are UTC [window_start, window_end); sample_count counts timed rows in that window, invalid_time_sample_count counts invalid or uncertain samples received during it, and gap_count counts null bins.

AlertEventDTO.description: A reading crossing carries its sample, value and applied limit and a null sequence_id. A feeding outcome references its feed sequence and has null reading facts; it is raised once per sequence and kind when the sequence reaches that final status.
